priority: Comparative capability usefulness and correct selection on representative repository workloads

gates.name: current_v5_development_conformance
gates.need: Exact changed-pack execution approval after source verification
gates.success_means: The grader accepts published source repairs and rejects broken/original source on three development issues, under its reviewed runtime

gates.name: licensed_reproducible_independent_corpus
gates.need: Review rights, safe archives, exact dependency closure, untouched baseline, repaired reference and preservation for every adopted case; add real multi-file and source-grounded no-change coverage
gates.success_means: Frozen source-disjoint 8 qualification,28 training,105 holdout assignments, with related origins grouped and development repositories excluded

gates.name: fresh_worker_and_capture_conformance
gates.need: Bind actual shared environment, candidate, transport, optional-use inventory, runtime and receipt/capture behavior to the new cohort
gates.success_means: Qualified execution boundary for this comparison, not evidence of candidate benefit

gates.name: comparative_usefulness
gates.need: Freeze and review actual four-arm plan after corpus adoption; required-use qualification, training-built challenger, then optional-use holdout comparison
gates.success_means: Task-specific value or a valid negative/inconclusive result, preserving missing measurements and measured candidate use separately

gates.name: selection_outcomes
gates.need: Independent prior value labels and a separate equal-inventory cohort comparing fixed family dispatch, discovery-only and real AEEP decisions; include overhead and missed useful choices
gates.success_means: Evidence of actual choices and verified task outcomes; unknown value never becomes useless or zero

gates.name: resource_qualification
gates.need: Observe real task and assessment overhead, derive workload-based operational thresholds before its independent holdout
gates.success_means: Infrastructure adequacy only, with no transferred claim about capability usefulness

gates.name: human_control_check
gates.need: Existing three-question assisted control follow-up; no agent proxy, model call or actual cancellation/removal is required
gates.success_means: Participant-specific comprehension with help recorded; no unaided or population-wide claim

gates.name: release_or_publication
gates.need: Separate explicit release/publication instruction after engineering/evidence gates
gates.success_means: Only the specifically authorized publication or release
